div.p: Groceries, medicine, doctor visits, NADRA paperwork — handled by vetted Faizies on the ground in Pakistan. Asked for on WhatsApp, confirmed in writing, finished with a photo.
You send money home every month. What you can't send is the hour it takes to queue at NADRA, the ride to the doctor, or somebody sitting with your mother while she has her tea. That's the part we do.

div.h2: Three steps. No app to learn.
div.p: You already use WhatsApp all day. So do we. The portal is there when you want the detail — receipts, photos, history — not because you're forced through it.

div.p: Your first three care activities are on us.
My mother's blood pressure medicine used to be a monthly argument with my brother about whose turn it was. Now it just arrives, and I see the photo.
The NADRA renewal would have cost me a flight. It cost me one WhatsApp message and a receipt.
What I pay for isn't the groceries. It's knowing somebody sat with my father for an hour and told me how he really was.

div.div: One task: a grocery run, a medicine collection, a doctor visit, a document errand, a companionship visit. Emergencies are never counted — we're not going to make you hesitate during a crisis.

h3.button: Do I have to be in the Gulf?

div.div: No. What matters is where your family is, not where you are. We have subscribers in Dubai and Riyadh, and just as many in London, Manchester and New York. Pick your currency on the pricing page — those are the prices we publish there, not today's exchange rate applied to an AED figure.
CNIC verification, references we actually call, an interview, and a signed code of conduct. Every task is rated afterwards, and ratings follow the Faizy.

Only our operations team and the Faizy assigned to that specific task. Health notes are restricted further. You can also mark any booking private, and the assigned Faizy sees the task and address but not who it's for.

h3.button: What do the fees actually mean?

div.div: You pay for what was bought, a service charge for running the errand, and a 5% platform fee on the purchase value. Every one of those appears as a separate line on your receipt. Nothing is rolled up or hidden.

h3.button: What if I need more than my plan allows?

div.div: Extra activities are billed individually at your plan's rate, shown on the same monthly invoice. We'd rather do the task and tell you than refuse your mother a doctor's visit.

div.p: No card needed to begin. Tell us who to look after, and we'll take it from there.
